_comment: Metadata for the CORE RULES capture only (source-core.md). Named meta-core.json rather than meta.json to avoid a concurrent write collision with the sibling agent capturing Necromunda campaign systems into the same research/sources/necromunda/ directory at the same time. Merge into a single meta.json when convenient.
title: Necromunda — Core Rules (N17/N23), via NecroRAW consolidation

primary_secondary_source.name: NecroRAW
primary_secondary_source.note: Community project, not affiliated with Games Workshop (site footer). robots: noindex, nofollow — no sitemap crawl possible, pages reached by following child links from section roots only. States it transcribes 100% verbatim (RAW) rules, tagged RAW/RAI/OBS per page.
primary_secondary_source.gotcha: The old necroraw.ru domain (no .com) is dead and now a link-farm; only necroraw.com.ru is legitimate.

cross_check_primary_sources.label: N23 Core Rulebook (Revised 2023) — the CORRECT N23 primary source
cross_check_primary_sources.library_master_path: G:\My Drive\Wargaming\NECROMUNDA\RULE BOOKS\Necromunda Core Rulebook Revised 2023.epub
cross_check_primary_sources.format_note: EPUB, not PDF. fitz.get_text() on rendered epub pages is badly truncated (multi-column CSS reflow artifact) — do not trust it. Unzipping as a plain zip archive and stripping the embedded XHTML tags directly gives clean complete text. Internal filenames encode print-page ranges, e.g. 142-163_NM_Core_Rulebook_23_EPUB-8.xhtml covers print pages 142-163.
verified_sections: Lasting Injury Table (print pp.126-127) — word-for-word match to NecroRAW
Advancement table + escalation rule (print pp.149-150) — word-for-word match to NecroRAW, all XP costs and credit increases confirmed
Gang Rating vs Wealth definitions (print p.92) — confirmed, more precise than the NecroRAW summary alone

cross_check_primary_sources.label: 1995 Necromunda Living Rulebook — MISLABELED as core-rulebook.pdf in this directory
cross_check_primary_sources.correction_note: This file is NOT the N23 Core Rulebook the filename implies. fitz metadata: title 'NECROLRB', creator 'QuarkXPress: LaserWriter 8', creationDate 2005-12-12 (Living Rulebook PDF-conversion date, content is the 1995 original). Page 1 text: 'Living Rulebook edition compiled by Andy Hall'. Kept deliberately as the 1995 primary-source data point for the injury-table and gang-rating lineage comparison (see Necromunda.md).
verified_sections: Serious Injuries D66 table (pp.83-85) — the direct 1995 ancestor of N23's Lasting Injuries table

THE GANG RATING / ADJUSTING THE GANG RATING (pp.83, 99-100) — 'value not included in the gang rating' for unassigned/hoarded equipment, stated three times (general rule + two item-specific examples for Screamers/Stummers)

licence_note: NecroRAW explicitly omits GW lore/artwork and states it exists to encourage buying the official books. Quoted here for analysis/citation only, per this vault's standing copyright policy — no rulebook PDF or full page transcription is committed to the repo.
